decisions.operational_reference: Deployed 3-channel hole landmark weights frozen 2026-08-26 15:49 KST (door_pipeline training session #6: 107 train / 27 holdout of 134 human labels = LAB + 16 field frames from session 20260810/E25_door_RH/s_091317). decisions.target_journal: Journal of the Korean Society of Manufacturing Technology Engineers (KSMTE)

rules: Thresholds, geometry gate, 30 mm CAD reject and peak threshold 0.15 are unchanged from v1/v2.
Distance scales are fit on fold-0 TRAIN sessions only, separately for each model and mode.
TEST frames and the 8 TEST-role field coordinates are used only for evaluation; no retuning after viewing TEST.

Metrics: frame and session accuracy over all inputs (abstentions in denominator), coverage, macro-F1, per-class recall, Wilson 95% interval for session accuracy, relative distance error (measured/CAD - 1), PCK8 on the 8 TEST-role field coordinates.
Fold-0 TEST is one fold of a retrospective period already observed in development; it is reported as a held-out fold result, not a prospective blind test.
Temporal-split and unregistered-class (E23) experiments are separate, later protocols.
